references.source: M. Schaefer & S. Turek, 'Benchmark computations of laminar flow around a cylinder', in E.H. Hirschel (ed.), Flow Simulation with High-Performance Computers II, Notes on Numerical Fluid Mechanics 52, Vieweg (1996) 547-566 (problem 2D-1, Re = 20); high-accuracy reference values from the FEATFLOW benchmark page https://wwwold.mathematik.tu-dortmund.de/~featflow/en/benchmarks/cfdbenchmarking/flow/dfg_benchmark1_re20.html ('reference results', computed with high-order methods); c_D = 5.57953523384; F = c rho U_bar^2 D / 2 per m depth, rho U_bar^2 D / 2 = 0.002 N/m
references.notes: Schaefer & Turek (1996) acceptance interval c_D in [5.57, 5.59] (from memory). The fixed solver converges to c_D = 5.5714 (-0.15 %, docs/benchmarks_cfd.md).

references.notes: Lift is ~0.2 % of drag and sensitive to the mesh; Schaefer & Turek (1996) acceptance interval c_L in [0.0104, 0.0110] (+-3 %, from memory).
